summary: Iter 166 — UI/UX standardization (7 points). Backend 7/7 tests PASS: eligible-employees admin/MOP scoping, project-request auto-CC resolution from material_category_id, category master cost_center CRUD, site master + inv_categories + request-types endpoints. Frontend mostly PASS: Leave Apply/Balances tabs have all required testids and search+scoping (MOP sees only Arjun Reddy E-1001), Project Request Center shortcuts (req-shortcut-leave, req-shortcut-advance) render, Service/Payment dialog has req-form-service-category / req-form-type / req-form-location / req-form-costcenter, Categories master has cat-form-costcenter. CRITICAL BUG: Advances 'New Advance Request' dialog is MISSING the promised project-filter + searchable employee UI — the JSX still renders a plain shadcn Select for employees and the `projFilter`/`filteredEmployees` state is defined in the component but never rendered/used. Required testid `emp-project-filter` is absent; `emp-select` exists but as a plain Select (not searchable input, no {testid}-list / {testid}-option-{id} pattern). Also spec-listed searchable option testid pattern for the Advances employee picker is not implemented.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing `emp-project-filter` dropdown and searchable employee UI. When on-behalf is enabled, the dialog only shows a plain <Select data-testid='emp-select'> listing ALL employees. The `projFilter` state + `filteredEmployees` memo (lines 289, 310-317) are defined but never rendered. Spec requires: (a) a Project (filter) select with data-testid `emp-project-filter` (incl. HEAD-OFFICE), (b) searchable employee input via EmployeeSearchSelect with `emp-select-list` and `emp-select-option-{id}` pattern (mirroring the Leave apply-employee flow). Also employees list should be sourced from GET /api/advances/eligible-employees for project scoping — currently it reads full employees list.

design_issues.screen: Advances New Dialog (and generally Select components)
issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (from ve-dynamic instrumentation) — same warning noted in prior iter reports, non-blocking.

action_items: Advances.jsx CreateAdvanceDialog: replace the plain <Select data-testid='emp-select'> block with the same pattern used in Leave.jsx apply tab — a Project (filter) select with data-testid `emp-project-filter` bound to `projFilter`, and the shared EmployeeSearchSelect (from /app/frontend/src/components/EmployeeSearchSelect.jsx) with testid `emp-select` iterating `filteredEmployees` (already computed). Options should render with data-testid `emp-select-option-{employee.id}`. Load candidates from GET /api/advances/eligible-employees instead of full employees list so PM/MOP roles only see their scoped employees.
(cosmetic) Fix <span> in <option> hydration warning in Select components — wrap plain text or move meta text out of native <option>.
critical_code_review_comments: Advances.jsx: state variables `projFilter` and `filteredEmployees` are declared and computed but never referenced in the render tree — dead code that misleads reviewers into thinking the feature is complete.

Advances.jsx currently reads GET /api/employees for the on-behalf list. Backend already exposes GET /api/advances/eligible-employees which enforces project scoping. Switch to the eligible-employees endpoint to make MOP/PM lists automatically project-scoped without extra client filtering.

project_requests_router.create_request: cost_center auto-resolve logic correctly matches by `category_id` OR `category_code` — good defensive fallback. But when a project has no cost_center row for the chosen category, cost_center_id ends up null and cost_center_label is null (silent). Consider surfacing a warning field like `cost_center_auto_resolved: false` so the UI can hint the user.

procurement_master_router CategoryIn.cost_center is a free-text field (Optional[str]) — no validation against `cost_centers` collection. Acceptable for a 'default hint' field but flag for future to switch to cost_center_id.

Login page inputs (login form) do not carry data-testid — tests must fall back to type='password' and positional selectors. Add `login-email` / `login-password` / `login-submit` testids for future automation stability.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — 6 of 7 spec areas fully working, Advances on-behalf project-filter/search UI missing

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend cost-center auto-resolve + category cost_center field + eligible-employees scoping are all verified green. If main agent adds the missing emp-project-filter + searchable EmployeeSearchSelect to Advances.jsx CreateAdvanceDialog, re-run test_iter166_ux_standardization.py (still passes as-is) and run a Playwright test that: (1) logs in as admin, opens /app/hr/advances, clicks 'New Advance Request', toggles on-behalf, verifies [data-testid='emp-project-filter'] exists, types 'Arjun' into [data-testid='emp-select'], clicks [data-testid='emp-select-option-{id}'], and confirms [data-testid='project'] auto-fills with 'PRJ-2025-01'. (2) Repeat as test_mop@erp.com and confirm only Arjun Reddy shows.
rca of the issue: Advances.jsx dialog UI drift — main agent added the `projFilter` state and `filteredEmployees` memo (lines 289-317) intending to wire a project-filter dropdown + searchable employee input above the on-behalf employee picker, but the JSX (lines 355-364) still renders the old plain <Select> that iterates the full `employees` array. As a result the promised testids `emp-project-filter` and the searchable {testid}-option-{id} pattern are absent, and admin/PM/MOP users all see the same unfiltered employee list (though backend still enforces authz at POST time). Repro: login as admin → /app/hr/advances → New Advance → check 'Create on behalf' → observe there is only one Employee <Select> and no separate Project (filter) dropdown. Fix: swap the JSX to mirror Leave.jsx apply tab (project filter <select> bound to projFilter + <EmployeeSearchSelect> bound to filteredEmployees, sourced from /api/advances/eligible-employees).
